Name: Clodsire Pigs (Pokemon)
Author: Altarios2
Description: This is a 1.6 compatible [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pok%C3%A9mon]Pokémon[/url] inspired mod that revolutionizes the basic and boring task of truffle hunting with the immensely stimulating activity of Clod watching. Witness as everyone's favorite plump boy crawls around unbothered by the troubles of farm life. This mod is compatible with other farm animal replacers, just remember to disable the pig replacer for any other mods to avoid any complication!

Downloads.Description: Update: Fixed a bug where the shop icon would not appear in Marnie's shop. Have a great day!
This is exactly like the standalone mod but it is now Alternative textures compatible. Big thanks to CelticRune2 for providing the code fir the conversion!
